title: add VPC control plane provisioning: subnets, endpoints, security groups, peering, DNS (Terraform)
author: Priya Nair
description:
Summary: Add opinionated Terraform modules and example top-level configuration for provisioning the VPC control plane used by Private deployments. This PR includes private subnets, service endpoints (S3/ECR/SSM), security group templates for control-plane+worker communication, cross-account VPC peering primitives, and Route53 private hosted zone / resolver rules for control-plane DNS.

Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood in VPC/on-prem modes need a repeatable, auditable Terraform path to create the control plane networking resources with secure defaults. This consolidates patterns we shipped ad-hoc into a supported module, enabling upgrades and rollbacks and reducing operator error.

What changed (high level):
- New terraform module modules/vpc-control-plane with documented variables and outputs
- resources: private_subnets, nat_gateways optional, interface endpoints for S3/ECR/SSM, gateway endpoints where applicable
- security: control_plane_sg, worker_node_sg, managed egress rules and least-privilege ingress for control-plane ports
- peering: optional cross-account peering configuration with lifecycle rules and route propagation helpers
- DNS: private hosted zone creation, conditional import of existing zones, Route53 Resolver rules for on-prem resolver forwarding, and cross-account delegation examples
- examples: examples/aws/complete_control_plane.tf demonstrating recommended setup for Dedicated/Private installer
- docs: modules/vpc-control-plane/README.md with usage, upgrade notes, and TL;DR security considerations

Checklist:
- [x] Terraform module + examples added
- [x] Unit tests for module validation (tfsec + tflint)
- [x] CI plan/apply gated (plan only on PR)
- [x] Docs and upgrade notes included
- [x] Security review by SRE/security team

Compatibility/upgrade notes: The module sets sensible defaults to be non-breaking for existing installs; enabling peering or DNS delegation requires explicit variables. See modules/vpc-control-plane/README.md for migration steps when importing existing VPCs or hosted zones.

Related: ENG-4823 (Private VPC baseline), INFRA-119 (Resolver/peering pattern).

test(ci): add tflint and tfsec pipeline steps for module
docs(module): document DNS/resolver and peering migration steps

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Left a few nits. Can we make the resolver rule creation opt-in? Some customers manage resolver outside infra.

Priya Nair: Restricted default egress to AWS service endpoints and customer-specified CIDR list; updated README.
Daniel Rios: Approve after addressing tfsec warnings on IAM policies used in peering role. Also request a short note in release notes about required IAM permissions.
Priya Nair: Addressed minimal IAM role with sts:AssumeRole for cross-account peering added; release note added.
release_notes: Add new 'vpc-control-plane' Terraform module to provision control-plane networking for Private deployments: subnets, endpoints (S3/ECR/SSM), security group templates, optional cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private DNS/resolver support. Migration steps and resolver opt-in documented. Requires additional IAM permissions documented in module README.
notes: This PR consolidates patterns used by early private installs. Keep an eye on cross-account peering lifecycle in the next release (ENG-4823 follow-up).
